item.title: AI Labs Face Dilemma Over Growing Calls for Safety Pause
item.description: AI developers increasingly agree that progress may require a slowdown, but no single lab can afford to halt alone.

item.title: Iran conflict highlights China's influence on global oil prices
item.description: Data from China's General Administration of Customs, charted by Matt Phillips/Axios, shows China's significant role in oil price dynamics.

item.title: The $2 million campaign to unseat Rep. Andy Ogles in the GOP primary
item.description: A super PAC investing millions to oust Rep. Andy Ogles (R-Tenn.) is adding $700,000 to support his primary challenger in the final stretch.

item.title: U.S. launches new airstrikes in Iran
item.description: The U.S. military conducted a heavy wave of airstrikes in Iran on Wednesday evening, according to U.S. Central Command.
